steps.title: What this does
steps.confirm: I understand that agents I allow can fully control the computers I add.
steps.body:
This lets your agents work on other computers, over your private Tailscale network. There are three levels:

- **Look:** list the computers, see facts about them, and take screenshots.
- **Act:** run commands as administrator.
- **Drive:** use the mouse and keyboard.

The computer's own remote-control program does not ask the person at the PC before it runs a command. So My Maestro asks **you, on your phone,** before an agent's first Act or Drive in each session. Every agent starts at Look.

We strongly recommend a **dedicated PC with nothing personal on it.** An agent you allow to Act or Drive can do anything on that computer.

steps.title: Install
steps.body: Installs the remote-control server this connector runs (MeshCentral). It downloads about 210 MB in all (more space on disk once unpacked): about 85 MB of server programs now, and about 125 MB of helper programs for the PCs, which are downloaded the first time the server starts. It is only downloaded once. Nothing is installed on any other computer in this step.

steps.title: Your settings
steps.body: These settings are for **My Maestro's computer**, the computer My Maestro runs on. They are **not** about the PC you want to control. Find its name and its 100.x address in the Tailscale app on My Maestro's computer, or run `tailscale status` there in a terminal. If you are using My Maestro from a phone or another computer, you are not at that computer: ask Maestro to look the name and address up for you. The name looks like hub.example.ts.net and the address like 100.64.0.10. The ports can stay as they are.

steps.title: Start the server
steps.body: Starts the server and checks that it is running. This can take a minute the first time. You do not need to be at My Maestro's computer: if the server needs an administrator command, press **Ask Maestro** and Maestro runs it for you (it needs administrator rights on My Maestro's computer). Or run the command yourself in a terminal on My Maestro's computer: it is shown here.

steps.title: Prepare the PC
steps.body:
On the PC you want to add:

1. Use **Windows 11** with a **local account**, not a Microsoft account.
2. Set it to **sign in automatically** and to **never lock or sleep.** Screenshots and mouse control need someone signed in.
3. Install **Tailscale** and sign in to the same tailnet as My Maestro's computer.
4. Keep personal files and accounts off it.
5. **Don't sign in to My Maestro on that PC:** an agent using the PC could use that sign-in.

steps.title: Get the installer
steps.body: Makes a link that works once, for 15 minutes. Open it in a browser on the PC. It downloads the helper program. Open the link on the PC right away. If you change settings or restart My Maestro first, make a new link.

steps.title: Check the PC is connected
steps.body: After you run the helper on the PC, check that it shows up here. It can take a minute.

steps.title: What agents may do
steps.body: Write one entry per agent, like `maestro:look`, `maestro:act` or `maestro:drive`. **Look** is pictures and facts. **Act** also runs commands. **Drive** also uses the mouse and keyboard. Agents you do not list get Look. Act and Drive always need your yes on the phone, once per session; the session length is the second setting.

steps.title: Who can use it at all
steps.body: Choose which agents may use remote computers. The lead agent is always allowed. Each allowed agent still gets only the level you chose in the last step.
